result.instructions:
For questions about a material's performance, cost, complexity or optimization (Fortnite runs on mobile devices), read the skill /Script/MaterialCostTools.MaterialCostOptimizationSkill first, and use MaterialCostTools.MaterialCostToolset: GetCost measures a material and compares it with the open map's materials, GetGraph returns its whole graph in one call.

The editor is displaying positions and rotations to the user in LUF (Left-Up-Forward, the Verse/UEFN coordinate convention), but tool calls do not convert: they still take and return the engine's native XYZ (Forward-Right-Up) coordinates directly, so translate to/from LUF yourself when describing them to the user.
